description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2815005297992 PARTS KIT,ENGINE PO: Line 0001 Qty 7515 UI KT Deliver To: By: 0087 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 1127. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 72582 23500501; 7U177 FP-23500501. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
